{{Quote|Few Mandalorian clans were united on the subject: The New Mandalorians, True Mandalorians, and Death Watch could all claim Ordos, Vizslas, Kryzes, Fetts, Awauds, and Tenaus as supporters.|Vilnau Teupt, ''Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul''|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Clan Tenau''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]], a conflict of ideals waged between the radical and violent [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], and the honorable [[Jaster Mereel]]'s [[True Mandalorians]], while the peace-favoring [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] stood apart. During the societal schism, members of Clan Tenau were divided, with each of the three factions garnering support from individual clan members.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Tenau was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2012]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].
